title: 第1970章 四象联动紫郢复仇第1969章 一步登天叶蚯圣君
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
陈景安则消失在所有人的视线中。
哪怕是仙族中人，也再没能得到半点与他相关的消息。
陈青玄与陈青机通过“天机”，倒是知道了陈景安的意图。
他想要争夺界河即将出世的“合体之位”。
只是这并不容易。
因为陈景安的对手是界河的天道，它为了这个位置已经谋划了十万年之久。
这时间的跨度不是陈景安这短短几十年所能比拟的。
不过，陈景安身上似乎就有着那种契机。
天机的结果显示。
陈景安这一趟对应的卦象是“中吉”。
这就证明了他至少拥有一半的胜算。
陈青玄有心想要提供些助力，但他这临时借来的返虚之力，用来恐吓修士尚可，若是真的用来对抗天道，恐怕会在一瞬间被戳穿。
他只能从其他方向上努力，争取削弱天道的优势。
陈青玄将重点放在陈景安给他的那部分传承上。
这囊括了北海，东海与西海。
每一处都有着独特的禀赋，可以培育出相应的叶蚯。
陈青玄凭借返虚境的实力。
他能够自由穿行于四海之间，获取培养叶蚯需要的各类素材。
陈青玄这一次的追求不再只是叶蚯品种。
他想要让自己的叶蚯之间，形成一种相互的联系，就如同四海的四神那样。

这就涉及到了更深层次的理解。
对陈青玄而言，同样是更进一步的契机。
他开始潜心参悟。
……
就这样，百年的时间过去。
界河又迎来了新势力的起落，陈氏仙族巩固了手里的地盘。
他们有返虚坐镇。
时至今日，陈氏仙族已然成为了界河的超级势力之一。
外界不少人好奇“叶蚯圣君”的斤两，但迟迟没有人主动打上门来。
直到这一天。
西海的下方忽然有一团紫光亮起。
这团紫光当场凝聚成了一双巨大的手爪，带着毁天灭地的气势，就是冲着毁灭西洲来的。
千钧一发之际。
content_en:
Chen Jingan disappeared from everyone's sight.
Even people from the Immortal Clan have not been able to get any information related to him.
Chen Qingxuan and Chen Qingji came to know Chen Jingan's intentions through the "Tianji".
He wants to compete for the "integration position" that Jiehe will soon be born into.
It's just not easy.
Because Chen Jingan's opponent is Jiehe's Tiandao, which has been planning for this position for a hundred thousand years.
This span of time is beyond what Chen Jingan can compare with in just a few decades.
However, Chen Jingan seems to have that kind of opportunity.
The results of Tianji are displayed.
The hexagram corresponding to Chen Jingan's trip is "Zhongji".
This proves that he has at least half the chance of winning.
Chen Qingxuan wanted to provide some help, but the temporarily borrowed power of returning to the void could be used to intimidate the monks. If it was really used to fight against the law of heaven, it would probably be exposed in an instant.
He can only work hard in other directions to try to weaken the advantage of Heavenly Dao.
Chen Qingxuan focused on the part of the inheritance given to him by Chen Jingan.
This includes the North Sea, East China Sea and West China Sea.
Each place has a unique endowment and can cultivate corresponding leaf earthworms.
Chen Qingxuan relies on the strength of the Return to Void Realm.
He can travel freely between the four seas and obtain all kinds of materials needed to cultivate leaf earthworms.
Chen Qingxuan's pursuit this time is no longer just about the leaf earthworm variety.
He wanted to form a mutual connection between his leaves and earthworms, just like the four gods in the world.
This involves a deeper understanding.
For Chen Qingxuan, it is also an opportunity to go further.
He began to study with great concentration.
…
In this way, a hundred years passed.
Jiehe has ushered in the rise and fall of new forces, and the Chen Clan's Immortal Clan has consolidated its territory.
They have the ability to return to the virtual world and sit in charge.
Today, the Chen Clan's Immortal Clan has become one of the superpowers in Jiehe.
Many people in the outside world are curious about the identity of "Shengjun Ye Earthworm", but no one has taken the initiative to knock on the door.
Until this day.
Suddenly a group of purple light lit up below the West Sea.
This group of purple light condensed into a pair of huge claws on the spot, carrying the aura of destroying the world and destroying the world, aiming to destroy Xizhou.
At the critical moment.
